text: {"lessons":["My account is still below its early value despite a modest rebound, so I should review its risk regularly rather than assume that holding alone will protect my savings.","Selling B, E and D at substantial losses showed me to avoid reacting impulsively to declines; I should make measured decisions based on each holding and my financial needs.","As a retired investor relying on these savings, I should favor diversification and stability, trade sparingly, and avoid risks I cannot afford."]}
